title: onboard-orionx-lite-4b-v1.0-metadata-perf-profiles-changelog-automation
author: Priya Nair
description:
Onboard OrionX-Lite 4B v1.0 into the model registry with metadata, performance profiles, and automated changelog/release notes wiring. Motivation: OrionX-Lite is a compact variant of OrionX family optimized for low-latency inference on T4/A10-class hardware; adding it expands our lightweight model catalog and provides customers a predictable cost/latency option. This PR includes: 1) model metadata (architecture, tokenizer, weight locations, license, tags), 2) performance profiles generated from internal perf-lab runs (throughput, median P99 latency at common seq lengths, kv-cache behavior), 3) artifacts to hook the model into the changelog automation so onboarding appears in release notes and the model catalog page, and 4) a small validation script to sanity-check perf-profile => serving compatibility. Checklist:
- [x] Add metadata.yaml for models/orionx-lite-4b/v1.0
- [x] Add perf profile JSON under perf/profiles/ with measured numbers and SLO suggestions
- [x] Wire changelog automation: add entry template and ensure generate_release_notes picks it up
- [x] CI: unit tests for metadata parsing and perf-profile schema validation
- [x] Manual validation: smoke-run on a small T4 pool (latency/throughput sample)
Notes on perf data: profiles were produced by perf-canary runs on 1xT4 (g4dn.xlarge equivalent) and 1xA10. Numbers include median P50/P95/P99 and bytes-per-token estimates to help cost modeling. Perf profiles include fields used by the serving runtime (preferred kernel hint, quantization compatibility tags). Migration considerations: no breaking changes to schema; added optional fields for quantization_notes that older clients will ignore. Testing: ran the registry unit tests, perf profile schema checks, and a quick inference smoke test. Release process: once merged the changelog automation will generate an onboarding entry under changelog/auto which is picked up by the site generator on next docs build. Related: ENG-2048 (onboarding pipeline improvements), PM-512 (catalog placement).

release_notes: Onboarded OrionX-Lite 4B v1.0: lightweight OrionX variant optimized for low-latency inference. Included metadata, performance profiles for T4/A10, and automatic changelog entry. Customers can now select 'orionx-lite-4b:v1.0' from the catalog. Recommended deployment: quantized int8 on T4 for best cost/latency tradeoff.
